import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
CRIME_PATH = "chunks_csv/moran_local_no2crime_crime_first_half_2011.csv"
ADJ_PATH   = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

crime = pd.read_csv(CRIME_PATH)        # columns: borough, value
adj   = pd.read_csv(ADJ_PATH)          # columns: borough, neighbor

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Drop borough with missing crime‐rate and purge adjacency list
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
missing_mask = crime["value"].isna()
missing_boroughs = set(crime.loc[missing_mask, "borough"])
crime = crime.loc[~missing_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

# remove edges that reference any missing borough
adj = adj.loc[~adj["borough"].isin(missing_boroughs) &
              ~adj["neighbor"].isin(missing_boroughs)].reset_index(drop=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build symmetrical adjacency dictionary
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
neighbors = {b: set() for b in crime["borough"]}
for row in adj.itertuples(index=False):
    neighbors[row.borough].add(row.neighbor)
    neighbors[row.neighbor].add(row.borough)   # ensure symmetry

# remove boroughs that now have NO neighbours (after the purge)
zero_neighbor = {b for b, nbs in neighbors.items() if len(nbs) == 0}
crime = crime.loc[~crime["borough"].isin(zero_neighbor)].reset_index(drop=True)
for b in zero_neighbor:
    neighbors.pop(b, None)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare spatial weights matrix (row-standardised)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
boroughs = crime["borough"].tolist()
index    = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}
n        = len(boroughs)

# binary weight matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for i, b in enumerate(boroughs):
    for nb in neighbors[b]:
        if nb in index:                       # safety
            j = index[nb]
            W[i, j] = 1

# row-standardise
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
W = np.divide(W, row_sums, where=row_sums != 0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Compute z-scores, local Moran’s I, permutation p-values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
values = crime["value"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
z      = (values - values.mean()) / values.std(ddof=0)

# observed local Moran's I
local_I = z * (W @ z)

# permutation test (999 permutations)
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=2026)
perm_I = np.empty((1000, n))
perm_I[0] = local_I        # first row is observed

for k in range(1, 1000):
    z_perm = rng.permutation(z)
    perm_I[k] = z_perm * (W @ z_perm)

# two-sided pseudo p-values
abs_obs   = np.abs(perm_I[0])
abs_perm  = np.abs(perm_I)
greater   = (abs_perm >= abs_obs).sum(axis=0)
p_values  = (greater) / 1000        # includes observed row already

# local spatial lag for HH / LL sign test
lag_z = W @ z

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Classify boroughs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
results = []
for i, b in enumerate(boroughs):
    if p_values[i] < 0.05:                     # statistically significant
        if   (z[i] > 0) and (lag_z[i] > 0):
            label = "HH"
        elif (z[i] < 0) and (lag_z[i] < 0):
            label = "LL"
        else:
            continue                           # HL or LH, ignore
        results.append((b, label, local_I[i]))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Reporting
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
data_points_used = n
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")

if results:
    formatted = ", ".join([f"{b} ({lab}, Local Moran I = {val:.3f})"
                           for b, lab, val in results])
    print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {formatted}")
else:
    print("FINAL ANSWER: none")
